name: Afesis: los cuatro peldaños
source:
We play as Dimas, who, after making a grave mistake, becomes trapped in various addictions that affect both his life and the lives of those around him. His story is not that of a hero, but of someone who has fallen... and still doesn't know if he will be able to get back up.

In his search for redemption, Dimas relies on God not as an immediate solution, but as a long and painful path toward repentance. As he tries to repair the damage done, the everyday begins to intertwine with the spiritual: demonic temptations, symbols, and presences will test his will.

"Faith is not a solution. It is a path." "To choose good, one must know it."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4352080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们扮演迪马斯，他在犯了一个严重的错误后，陷入了各种成瘾的困境，影响了他的生活和周围人的生活。他的故事不是一个英雄的故事，而是一个跌倒的人的故事……并且仍然不知道他是否能够重新站起来。

在寻求救赎的过程中，迪马斯依靠上帝并不是立即的解决方案，而是一条漫长而痛苦的悔改之路。当他试图修复所造成的伤害时，日常生活开始与精神交织在一起：恶魔的诱惑、象征和存在将考验他的意志。

“信仰不是解决方案。它是一条道路。” “要选择善，必须了解它。”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4352080/]Steam[/url]]
